study_identification_part.si4_title: Gray matter atrophy is constrained by normal structural brain network architecture in depression

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study objectives are clearly stated. The research hypotheses/questions are provided: (1) investigating the association between gray matter atrophy and normal connectome architecture at individual level in depression, (2) hypothesizing that shared disease epicenters are anchored to brain 'hub' regions, and (3) hypothesizing that brain regions with stronger connections to disease epicenters show greater vulnerability. The purpose of applying normative modeling is clearly described: to infer individual-level GMV differences by measuring deviates from the healthy distribution, addressing neuroanatomical heterogeneity in depression. Both criteria are satisfied.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "In this study, we aimed to investigate the association between gray matter atrophy and normal connectome architecture at individual level in depression." ; "we hypothesized that these shared disease epicenter(s) were anchored to brain 'hub' regions.
